name: Hibari (雲雀, "Skylark")
concept: An Envoy-class Frame built to call the shot, not throw the punch — a strange fit for a pilot whose whole instinct is to step in front of the hit herself. Its voice carries across a battlefield the way a real Envoy's does at street scale, just kilometres louder.

classFeatures.name: Rally the Line
classFeatures.description: A shouted, kilometre-carrying command that steadies an ally's next action — Envoy's real support identity, reflavored at Frame scale. Documented here as a real ability, not yet wired into the battle simulator: this project's AI framework has real, tested mechanisms for a bonus-granting support action (Spot, design doc §14d/§14h), but Rally the Line's exact SF2E mechanical shape wasn't independently researched or built this pass — a real next step, flagged rather than glossed over.

notes: DRAFT — proposed 2026-08-22 at Ingram's direct request, open to full revision. Grounded in GM Core pg. 121-124's real level-12 tables: AC Moderate (32), HP Moderate (215) — not a striker archetype, so no reason to trend toward either extreme. Warning Shot uses Low-tier attack (+20) deliberately (Envoy isn't meant to be a primary damage dealer) with Moderate-tier damage (3d6+10) as a fallback option, not its point. Rally the Line (its real signature identity) is documented but not yet battle-simulator-wired — see its own description field for why; this is the one Frame in this batch with an honestly-flagged capability gap rather than a forced mechanical answer.
